item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-21 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-03 Fisica sperimentale della materia e applicazioni

The research programme aims to develop ultracompact quantum light sources based on van der Waals materials. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Ultrafast nonlocal metasurfaces for dynamic control of light - 2026_CDR_DFIS_10 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-21 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-03 Fisica sperimentale della materia e applicazioni

The activity will focus on the study and development of a photonic device based on high-quality-factor optical metasurfaces, with particular attention to their ultrafast optical response and light-matter interactions. It will include the use of ultrafast spectroscopy and linear optical characterizations to study resonances, nonlocal responses, angular dispersion, and optical nonlinearities, targeting ultrafast all-optical control and the development of meta-devices for high-sensitivity molecular sensing. Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-05 Astrofisica e cosmologia, fisica dello spazio, della terra e del clima

The research activities within the Research Centre will focus on the development and/or application of advanced algorithms for the analysis of ultraviolet-visible (UV-Vis) and infrared remote sensing measurements acquired from both ground-based and satellite platforms. These methodologies will be employed to retrieve key atmospheric parameters, including vertical profiles and total column amounts of trace gases and atmospheric constituents (e.g., NO₂, O₃, and H₂O). The project, developed within CODYBE and primarily aligned with FIS Line 2.3 “Higher-order evolutionary processes,” proposes a theoretical and computational study of how social interactions and network structure shape collective intelligence. A general model of collective tasks will be analyzed, and its predictions will be compared with behavioral experiments. The research is structured into two main lines: 1. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Sviluppo di detector a cascata quantica basati su Ge/SiGe quantum wells per fotonica integrata nel medio infrarosso - 2026_CDR_DFIS_9 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-03 Fisica sperimentale della materia e applicazioni

The research activities are in the framework of the MIDSENSE project. MIDSENSE aims to develop and experimentally validate a fully integrated mid-infrared (MIR) sensing platform based entirely on silicon-compatible photonics technologies. The core objective is the realization of Ge/SiGe Quantum Cascade Detectors (QCDs)[1,2] monolithically integrated within silicon photonic circuits to enable compact, scalable, and low-noise molecular sensing systems operating in the MIR fingerprint region.
